name: FireworksRecipes
description: Fireworks 配方目录。每条对应一个可一键安装并发布到 DGX Spark 集群的模型配方；nodes 为固定拓扑，发布时必须恰好匹配。
description_en: Fireworks recipe catalog. Each entry is a model recipe you can install and publish to a DGX Spark cluster with one click; nodes declare a fixed topology you must match exactly.

recipes.params: 176.9B（51.2B PLE 表 NVMe 离载）/ NVFP4
recipes.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（176.9B，Mia-AiLab NVFP4 checkpoint ~99 GB）单节点 TP=1 vLLM 服务（1× DGX Spark）：26.82 GiB n-gram/PLE 查找表由 NVMe 内存映射离载（VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 + MADV_RANDOM + PLE prefetch，每 token 磁盘读 1,366→57 KiB）、MTP 训练草稿 k=3 投机 + 可选 reduced-vocabulary drafting（MTP_DRAFT_VOCAB，+25% decode）、FP8 KV（≈1.85× KV 池，→512k 下 2.73× 满请求）、BF16 GDN/SSM 常驻状态 + V2 runner 固定（上游 09-06 shipped）、262,144 原生上下文（YARN=1 → 524,288 YaRN）、宿主侧 HOST_RESERVE 封顶 GPU 预算（KV_TARGET_GIB 20 → GMU 0.786）、推理默认开（reasoning 字段单独返回、可每请求关）、OpenAI API + 图片/视频多模态；sparkDash 实测 decode 单流 ~46–49 tok/s（4 流聚合 108–114、8 流 162.9）、prefill 峰值 ~2,265 tok/s @32k。源自 MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Single-DGX-Spark（AGPL-3.0 配方参考）。
recipes.description_en: Single-node TP=1 vLLM serving for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (176.9B, Mia-AiLab NVFP4 checkpoint ~99 GB) on one DGX Spark: the 26.82 GiB n-gram/PLE lookup table is offloaded and memory-mapped from NVMe (VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 + MADV_RANDOM + PLE prefetch, 1,366 -> 57 KiB disk read per token), MTP trained-draft k=3 speculation with optional reduced-vocabulary drafting (MTP_DRAFT_VOCAB, +25% decode), FP8 KV (~1.85x KV pool, -> 2.73x a full request at 512k), BF16 GDN/SSM recurrent state + V2 runner pinned (upstream 09-06 shipped), 262,144 native context (YARN=1 -> 524,288 YaRN), host-side HOST_RESERVE caps the GPU budget (KV_TARGET_GIB 20 -> GMU 0.786), reasoning on by default (separate reasoning field, disable per request), OpenAI API with image/video multimodal; measured with sparkDash - decode ~46-49 tok/s single-stream (108-114 aggregate at 4, 162.9 at 8), prefill peak ~2,265 tok/s @32k. Ported from MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Single-DGX-Spark (AGPL-3.0 reference).
recipes.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（单节点 TP=1 · MiaAI-Lab）

recipes.description: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio（Int4-Int8Mix unpruned）四节点 TP=4 + DCP4 服务：AEON v0.27.1 平台镜像 + b12x + spark-kit 生产 overlay（B12X MLA SPARSE + a2a + MTP k=2 + nvfp4_ds_mla + 315,968 上下文）。
recipes.description_en: 4-node TP=4 + DCP4 serving for GLM-5.2 QuantTrio (Int4-Int8Mix unpruned): AEON v0.27.1 platform image + b12x + spark-kit production overlays (B12X MLA SPARSE + a2a + MTP k=2 + nvfp4_ds_mla + 315,968 context).
recipes.name: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio DCP4

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 量化四节点 TP=4 服务（上游当前默认配置：fp8 KV + DFlash2 k=7 块扩散投机）：v11-dflash2 镜像（内置上游 v1→v9 patch 栈 + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer 模块）、fp8_e4m3 KV（每 rank 24GiB = 3,895,606-token 池，3.72× 满 1M）、最大并发 64 + max-num-batched-tokens 16384 + FULL_AND_PIECEWISE cudagraph（对齐上游 2026-09-02 提速 run）、默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）、1,048,576 上下文；gate 通过（2026-08-29：单流 54.5 tok/s、prefill 4,141.8 tok/s；09-02 提速后聚合 ~503–530 tok/s）。
recipes.description_en: 4-node TP=4 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) on the upstream current default config (fp8 KV + DFlash2 k=7 block-diffusion spec decode): v11-dflash2 image (upstream v1→v9 patch stack + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer module included), fp8_e4m3 KV (24 GiB/rank = 3,895,606-token pool, 3.72x a full 1M), max-num-seqs 64 + max-num-batched-tokens 16384 + FULL_AND_PIECEWISE cudagraph (aligned with the upstream 2026-09-02 speed run), default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption), 1,048,576 context; gate-passed (2026-08-29: 54.5 tok/s single-stream and 4,141.8 tok/s prefill; ~503-530 tok/s aggregate after the 09-02 speed run).
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 DFlash2

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 双节点 TP=2 服务（fp8 KV + DFlash2 块扩散投机）：上游「the one to copy」档位——C1–C6 并发扫描零失败、warm 单流 46.9 tok/s（74.1% 接受率，结构化 54–61 tok/s）、262,144 上下文、--max-num-batched-tokens 8192（上游 2026-08-30 pin，TP4 实测 C4 并发 +57%，与拓扑无关）、KV 固定 6 GiB（上游 2026-09-02 pin：678,661-token 池，负载 6 次 preemption→0）· --enforce-eager；v11-dflash2 镜像（与 TP4 DFlash2 同一镜像）+ 默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) NVFP4 quant — fp8 KV + DFlash2 block-diffusion spec decode, the upstream 'the one to copy' tier: C1-C6 concurrency sweep with zero failures, warm single-stream 46.9 tok/s (74.1% acceptance; 54-61 tok/s structured), 262,144 context, max-num-batched-tokens 8192 (upstream 2026-08-30 pin, +57% C4 aggregate at TP4, topology-agnostic), pinned 6 GiB KV (upstream 2026-09-02: 678,661-token pool, 6 preemptions → 0 under load) [--enforce-eager]; v11-dflash2 image (same as the TP4 DFlash2 recipe) + default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption).
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 DFlash2 TP=2

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE）双节点 TP=2 EXL3/TR3 服务：Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw 权重镜像、fp8_ds_mla KV、DFlash2 k=7 投机（drafter 跨 TP 分片）、EXL3_FAT_KERNEL=1（E2 内核）+ MNBT 7168（上游 2026-09-01 E2 默认）、1M 上下文（padded slot-share）、Vision 默认开——ACR 烘焙镜像（上游现行 Dockerfile @c707598，E2 内核 + 7 个运行时补丁全量入镜像）；decode 单流 62.9 tok/s（×2 聚合 103.3 / ×4 聚合 146.5）。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 EXL3/TR3 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE): Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw weight mirror, fp8_ds_mla KV, DFlash2 k=7 speculation (drafter sharded across TP), EXL3_FAT_KERNEL=1 (E2 kernel) with MNBT 7168 (upstream 2026-09-01 E2 default), 1M context (padded slot-share), Vision on by default — ACR-baked image (upstream current Dockerfile @c707598, E2 kernel + all seven runtime patches baked in); 62.9 tok/s single-stream (x2 aggregate 103.3 / x4 aggregate 146.5).
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 TP=2
